# UNYON

UNYON is a private, local-first desktop AI copilot for macOS and Windows.

## Core capabilities

- On-device live transcription for microphone and computer audio
- Real-time meeting and interview assistance
- Context-aware answers using private PDFs, DOCX files, images, text, and code
- Local AI chat and locally saved notes
- Movable desktop overlay with best-effort operating-system capture protection

UNYON is currently beta software. The macOS Apple silicon beta is available at:
https://myunyon.com/downloads/UNYON-1.0.0-arm64.dmg

Official website: https://myunyon.com/
Contact: hello@myunyon.com
